compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a list of saved audio recordings. The main contents and functions include:

1. **Title Bar**: At the top, there is a title bar with the text "Saved Audios" indicating the current section of the app.
2. **Back Button**: On the left side of the title bar, there is a back arrow icon to navigate to the previous screen.
3. **Audio File**: Below the title bar, there is a list item representing a saved audio file. The file is named "2017-04-18__13-52-43".
4. **Play Button**: To the right of the audio file name, there is a play button icon to play the audio file.
5. **Dropdown Arrow**: Next to the play button, there is a dropdown arrow icon, likely for additional options or actions related to the audio file.

The screen is designed to manage and play saved audio recordings.
